_comment: Resolved 2026-08-27 against live SEC EDGAR and GCM DealCloud. Confirmed by the user for BlackRock. Do not re-resolve on every run: read edgar.cik and dealcloud.entry_id straight from here.

_schema.edgar.cik: 10-digit zero-padded SEC CIK. null = deliberately not used; see edgar.note.
_schema.edgar.use: false means never pull 13F for this fund, for the stated reason.
_schema.last_quarter_seen: Written back by the weekly run; used to skip an unchanged 13F.

funds.caveat: Large private book. 13F weights are share of the long US-listed equity sleeve only and materially overstate position size versus total AUM.

edgar.note: NO USABLE 13F. EDGAR name search for 'BlackRock' returns BLACKROCK ADVISORS LLC (CIK 0001086364) whose last 13F-HR is 2016-12-31, and BlackRock Finance, Inc. (CIK 0001364742) last filed 2024-06-30. Neither is the STA strategy fund. BlackRock's firm-wide 13F would reflect ~$11T of index/ETF assets and is meaningless as a proxy for a single hedge fund strategy. DealCloud is the only valid source for this fund.

dealcloud.name: BlackRock
dealcloud.note: User-confirmed 2026-08-27. Ambiguous: DealCloud also holds 332065 'BlackRock, Inc.' (which carried the MORE RECENT note, 'PMM: BlackRock STA July 2026 Update', 2026-08-11) and 332979 'DSP Blackrock Asset Management'. User selected 332064. If a run finds 332064 has gone quiet while 332065 keeps receiving STA notes, raise it rather than switching silently.

funds.caveat: DealCloud-only fund: no 13F is pulled for BlackRock Strategic by design.

edgar.note: Files under 'Aspex Management (HK) Ltd'. An exact-string search for 'Aspex Management' still resolves, but search the short token 'Aspex' if re-resolving.

funds.caveat: Hong Kong based with substantial non-US exposure. The 13F captures only the US-listed long sleeve, so it is an incomplete view of the portfolio.
